items.q: How long does it really take to assemble one cabinet?
items.a: Budget 45 minutes or more per cabinet, depending on its size and your experience with a drill. A full kitchen is a real weekend project, not an hour of work, and we'd rather you know that going in.

items.q: Are the doors and drawers soft close by default, or is that an upgrade?
items.a: Standard, on every door and drawer, on every style. No upgrade needed.

items.q: Can I see these cabinets in person before I order?
items.a: Yes, at any of our six Connecticut showrooms: Bristol, Brookfield, New London, Newington, Orange, and Stamford. If you're not nearby, book a free virtual or in-home design consult instead.
Yes. 0% APR financing through GreenSky for qualifying customers, plus our Best Price Guarantee on every order.

items.q: Will I receive a new cabinet if something is damaged in the box?
items.a: In most cases we'll send a replacement part, not a whole new cabinet. A cracked door gets a new door, not an entirely new cabinet.

items.q: Will I be reimbursed for labor or time spent repairing damaged cabinets?
items.a: We're responsible for the replacement parts. We don't reimburse labor costs a customer incurs installing or repairing them.

items.q: How long do I have to inspect for concealed damage after delivery?
items.a: 5 days from delivery to open all cabinet and accessory boxes and check for damage or defects.

items.q: How can I pay for my order?
items.a: MasterCard, Visa, Discover, American Express, or GreenSky financing.

items.q: When will my card be charged?
items.a: At the time you place your order. Card authorization is required to submit it.

items.q: I don't like the finish or style once it arrives. Can I return my order?
items.a: We strongly recommend ordering door samples before you buy. Finish or style preference on its own isn't a returnable reason.

items.q: Do I need to be home for delivery?
items.a: Yes. Someone 18 or older must be present to accept and sign for it.

items.q: When will my order ship, and how long until it arrives?
items.a: RTA orders ship in 5 to 10 business days. Transit to your local freight terminal typically adds another 7 to 10 business days, depending on your location and carrier.

items.q: I mismeasured. Can I return a cabinet?
items.a: Yes, as long as it's unopened in its original packaging and isn't a non-returnable item. Contact us for a return authorization. Returns carry a 30% restocking fee.
